subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, and should the no-override path preserve shipped `bootstrap-extra-files` behavior for subagent and cron sessions?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but accepting a new config knob and changing default hook-extra behavior affects prompt context, session state, and upgrades in ways automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept After Compatibility Repair
options.body: Proceed with this PR shape only after restoring shipped no-override hook-extra behavior, keeping hook exclusion for explicit tiers, and adding public docs/tests for the accepted contract.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Bootstrap Selection
options.body: Pause this PR and design one selector contract that covers tiering, per-session filtering, hook extras, and related prompt-pressure work together.

options.title: Decline New Config Knob
options.body: Keep fixed session filters and steer users to existing context controls such as `contextInjection`, bootstrap budgets, and lightweight mode.

recommendation.title: Accept After Compatibility Repair
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR shape only after restoring shipped no-override hook-extra behavior, keeping hook exclusion for explicit tiers, and adding public docs/tests for the accepted contract.
